# Joan Pommelway

Joan Pommelway is the stylish, ginger-haired Manehattan Earth-pony mare in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* who pays homage to **Joan Holloway** from *Mad Men*. She is often seen beside **Roger Silvermane**, the pony homage to Roger Sterling; their being a couple is not established in the show. Look for her pale blue-white coat, turquoise eyes, orange updo, red dress, and gold jewelry. [Character and *Mad Men* comparison](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Mad_Men_ponies).

**Name and voice.** “Joan Pommelway” is a **Hasbro merchandise name**, documented on Wave 20 mystery-pack figures/cards, not a name spoken on-screen. Her collector card says she and Roger wear dressy outfits to work. [Wave 20 card catalog](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bag-cards/release/wave-20). She **does speak** in Season 8: in a British-sounding accent, she complains that the boutique tea is lukewarm. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Fake_It_%27Til_You_Make_It). A compiled voice-role listing attributes this English performance to **Tabitha St. Germain**, but I could not verify a character-specific on-screen credit. [Voice-role listing](https://fiction.wikisort.org/actor/en/Actor/Tabitha_St._Germain).

**Other appearances.** She appears in *Trade Ya!* (S4E22), *Made in Manehattan* (S5E16), *The Saddle Row Review* (S6E9), and *Daring Doubt* (S9E21), among other background scenes. She has no verified disguise or alter ego.

## Important moments

1. **A fashionable first sighting — “Rarity Takes Manehattan” (S4E8).** Joan and Roger share an outdoor café scene, introducing the *Mad Men* visual joke in the show's big-city setting. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mhj8F-I-7xk) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **The lukewarm-tea complaint — “Fake It 'Til You Make It” (S8E4).** As a customer in Rarity For You, Joan objects to her tea, prompting the increasingly imperious Fluttershy to scold the raccoon helpers. This is Joan's notable spoken scene. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LeixCyoTlQc) — scene timestamp unavailable.
